jobs.title: Junior project manager
jobs.description:
**Overview**

As a Junior Project Manager, you’ll help move technology projects from planning through delivery. You’ll coordinate schedules, requirements, stakeholders, and project updates across cross-functional teams, supporting software development, implementation, and IT infrastructure work. Your impact: Clear plans and timely communication help project teams stay aligned and enable stakeholders to make informed decisions.

**Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain project schedules, plans, and documentation using project management tools such as Microsoft Project, Jira, TFS, VersionOne, and SharePoint.
* Support requirements gathering, risk management, release management, and stakeholder communication across the software development life cycle (SDLC).
* Coordinate Agile, Scrum, Kanban, Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe), and Waterfall activities, including test cases and user acceptance testing.
* Track software implementation and enterprise solutions implementation involving cloud computing, AWS, databases, SQL, Oracle, and disaster recovery.
* Prepare status reports and project materials using Microsoft Office, including Word, Excel, and Visio.

\*

**Requirements**

* Project management experience in technology, with knowledge of project management methodology, project scheduling, project implementation, and IT project management.
* Understanding of Agile planning, PMBOK (Project Management Body of Knowledge), test-driven development, IT governance, and enterprise software.
* Strong communication, analysis, time management, organizational, and negotiation skills; able to support leadership and cross-functional collaboration.
* Technical proficiency and familiarity with IT infrastructure, cloud computing, and project management software.
* Technical project and program manager supervisory experience is preferred, not required. Experience with program management, team leadership, or technical project management is also a plus.

Pay: $55,000.00 - $65,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Implementation Manager Contractor
jobs.description:
Hummingbird is a remote-first, fully distributed team united by the shared mission of helping fight financial crime. Since our launch in 2017, we’ve helped major financial institutions and tech-savvy trailblazers alike (e.g. Plaid, Raymond James, Crypto.com etc.) orchestrate their compliance programs through our thoughtfully designed, intuitive, AI powered compliance tools. We believe finding and stopping financial crime is a problem rooted in code, language and design, so we built the product that the heroes doing this work deserve.

We are customer-obsessed, and we love building and shipping great products. We set a high bar, challenge our assumptions, seek diverse opinions, and support each other to do our best work.

We do our best to write inclusive, descriptive and accurate job descriptions, but we’re not always perfect. If you’re interested in the role, **we’d love to hear from you even if you don’t feel like you meet everything we’re looking for**. We’re always iterating and improving, and it’s possible that your experience is even more impactful than we could have imagined.

**About the Role**

As an Implementation Manager (Contractor), you’ll be the engine behind successful customer launches at Hummingbird. This contract role, working roughly 20 hours per week, will be responsible for implementations end-to-end — translating real customer business and technical requirements into a thoughtfully configured Hummingbird platform that meets our clients’ use cases.

This is a role for someone who loves both structure and problem-solving: you’ll manage timelines and stakeholders while getting hands-on with platform configuration, integrations, and workflows. If you're drawn to turning complexity into clarity and seeing customers succeed, this role was built for you.

  

**What you’re looking to do:**

* **Welcome new Hummingbird customers with open arms.** As one of the key points-of-contact just after a new customer signs on, you understand the impact that your role has!
* **Dive deep into technical intricacies.** Our product is highly configurable. You enjoy solving complex problems, and communicating that in a way that simplifies and brings clarity
* **Own all aspects of implementation**. With the support of the CS team, you’ll be responsible for driving client satisfaction, project scope, change requests, project status tracking, coordination of internal tasks, and reporting of project KPIs
* **Configure the Hummingbird platform** to meet customer business and technical requirements, within product capabilities
* **Manage multiple implementations** in parallel, prioritizing effectively and proactively flagging risks, tradeoffs, or scope changes

  

**What we’re looking for:**

* You thrive in owning ambiguous implementation work and turning loose requirements into clear plans, decisions, and outcomes
* Experience configuring B2B enterprise SaaS platforms or technical products based on real customer business and technical needs (not just running project plans)
* A strong cross-functional collaborator who enjoys working across the Customer Success org - with Technical Solutions Engineers, Implementation Managers, and our Head of Delivery to get things shipped
* You're organized, proactive, and reliable — you manage your own priorities well and surface risks or blockers early
* Someone who’s energized by a fast-moving, evolving environment

**What’s in it for you:**

* **The chance to help have a real impact on how we deliver.**
* **Competitive hourly rate**.
* **Remote-first,** fully distributed company with flexible working hours.
* **Safe, respectful & comfortable** work environment with colleagues and leadership who prioritize diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please don't hesitate to contact us to request accommodation.

jobs.title: IT Project Manager
jobs.description:
About Legence
  
**Legence (Nasdaq:** LGN) is a leading provider of engineering, consulting, installation, and maintenance services for mission-critical systems in buildings. The company specializes in designing, fabricating, and installing complex HVAC, process piping, and other mechanical, electrical, and plumbing (MEP) systems—enhancing energy efficiency, reliability, and sustainability in new and existing facilities. Legence also delivers long-term performance through strategic upgrades and holistic solutions. Serving some of the world’s most technically demanding sectors, Legence counts over 60% of the Nasdaq-100 Index among its clients.
  
  
Position Overview
  
Legence is seeking an experienced IT Project Manager to join the IT Project Management Office (PMO) and plan and deliver IT solutions and software projects that support business needs. This role leads projects through the software development lifecycle (SDLC), from initiation, requirements, and design through development, testing, release, and post-implementation support. The IT Project Manager is accountable for scope, schedule, budget, risks, dependencies, quality, and stakeholder communication. This position works closely with business stakeholders, product owners, development and QA teams, vendors, and IT Operations to ensure successful delivery of solutions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Client & Stakeholder Engagement
  

* Partner with business and IT stakeholders to define project objectives, business requirements, success criteria, priorities, and expectations for IT solutions and software projects.
* Provide project leadership and practical recommendations to sponsors, product owners, development teams, and business stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle.
* Serve as the primary project point of contact for scope, schedule, budget, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and delivery status.

Software Delivery & Project Execution
  

* Develop and maintain project charters, work plans, roadmaps, release schedules, budgets, resource plans, backlogs, risk and issue logs, decision logs, and delivery plans using established project management methods (Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid) and tools.
* Manage projects through each SDLC phase, including requirements, design, development, testing (including user acceptance testing), release, and post-implementation support.
* Coordinate release planning, change management, deployment, cutover, training, and transition to operations, ensuring deliverables align with approved requirements, quality standards, security and compliance requirements, release readiness criteria, and applicable policies.

Project & Cross-Functional Coordination
  

* Coordinate work across development, QA, business analysis, infrastructure, information security, IT Operations, and business teams to deliver integrated solutions.
* Interface with software vendors, implementation partners, contractors, and consultants throughout planning and delivery.
* Support vendor selection, statements of work, procurement activities, and oversight of vendor delivery as needed.

Documentation & Communication
  

* Document project requirements, assumptions, dependencies, decisions, risks, issues, lessons learned, and acceptance criteria.
* Organize and lead project meetings; prepare and distribute agendas, meeting notes, status reports, action items, and executive updates.
* Communicate project status, risks, and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, escalating issues in a timely manner.

Leadership & Resource Management
  

* Lead cross-functional project teams and coordinate internal and external resources to deliver work within approved scope, schedule, budget, and quality expectations.
* Monitor resource needs, workload, milestones, and deliverables; drive accountability for commitments and follow-through.

Desired Skills and Experience
  
  
Education & Credentials
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is required; PMI-ACP is preferred.

Experience
  

* Five or more years of project management experience delivering software or IT solution projects.
* Demonstrated experience managing projects through the full software development lifecycle, including requirements, design, development, testing, deployment, and post-implementation support.
* Experience working with development teams, QA, business analysts, product owners, business stakeholders, and vendors.
* Hands-on experience delivering projects using Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid methodologies.

Professional Skills
  

* Working knowledge of the SDLC, Agile and Waterfall methodologies, and software delivery practices such as release management, testing, and change control.
* Ability to develop and manage project schedules, budgets, resource plans, RAID logs, release plans, and executive-level status reporting.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and project or work management tools (such as Microsoft Project, Azure DevOps, Jira, or Smartsheet).
* Strong written and verbal communication, facilitation, organization, problem-solving, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences.

Additional Notes
  

* This role may require occasional travel to company locations or project sites to support project delivery.
* Other duties may be assigned as needed to support project delivery and team objectives.

**Base salary:** $120,000-$130,000 per year. This role may be eligible for participation in discretionary bonus plan based on company and individual performance.

jobs.title: Associate Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Odigo Group is a marketing and communications consultancy supporting clients ranging from global technology enterprises to growing businesses. We work collaboratively across complex, fast-moving programs where strong project coordination, organization, and communication are critical to successful delivery.

We are looking for an **Associate Project Manager** who is highly organized, proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable supporting multiple projects and priorities.

Role Overview

The Associate Project Manager will provide day-to-day project management and coordination support across client projects and internal workstreams. Working closely with project managers and program leads, this role will help keep timelines, deliverables, meetings, documentation, and project communications organized and moving forward.

This is a hands-on support role well suited for someone who is a strong communicator, takes initiative, follows through on details, and enjoys helping teams stay organized and on track.

Responsibilities

* Support project managers and program leads with day-to-day project coordination and execution.
* Maintain project plans, timelines, trackers, documentation, and status updates.
* Track deliverables, deadlines, action items, dependencies, feedback, and approvals.
* Coordinate across team members and stakeholders to help keep work moving according to schedule.
* Support project meetings, including agendas, notes, action items, and follow-up.
* Monitor project progress and proactively flag potential risks, delays, or outstanding needs.
* Help maintain organized project information and support consistent workflows across multiple projects.

Skills Required

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Proactive, dependable, and able to follow through on assigned responsibilities.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines, and workstreams.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Comfortable collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Ability to identify issues or blockers and escalate them appropriately.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities may shift.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and Microsoft Teams; familiarity with tools such as Monday.com and SharePoint is a plus.

Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, Project Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
* Previous experience in project coordination, project management, marketing, communications, operations, or a related role.
* Experience supporting cross-functional teams and multiple stakeholders preferred.
* Familiarity with project management tools and practices is a plus.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager (R6371)
jobs.description:
Shield AI is a venture-backed defense-tech company with the mission of protecting service members and civilians with intelligent systems. Its products include Hivemind autonomy software, V-BAT and X-BAT aircraft, and Aechelon simulation and synthetic reality technologies. With offices and facilities across the U.S., Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific, Shield AI’s technology actively supports operations worldwide. For more information, visit www.shield.ai. Follow Shield AI on LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube.

### **Job Description:**

The Senior Technical Project Manager – Enterprise Technology & Systems Delivery is a project delivery leader within the PMO organization responsible for managing technology programs and enterprise transformation initiatives across multiple workstreams. This role drives delivery from initiation through go-live and stabilization, ensuring tight schedule management, strong cross-functional coordination, proactive risk and issue escalation, and disciplined governance throughout the project lifecycle.

The role requires someone who can understand technical concepts, dependencies, and delivery risks well enough to coordinate effectively across engineering, infrastructure, integration, data, and testing teams, but who is not expected to serve as the hands-on technical lead or provide technical solution ownership. Success is defined by on-time execution, stakeholder alignment, effective governance, and sustainable adoption of technology-enabled change.

**What you'll do:**

* Lead end-to-end project management for technology implementations, platform migrations, system integrations, and transformation initiatives from charter through go-live and hypercare.
* Manage multiple concurrent workstreams, integrating business, engineering, infrastructure, data, testing, and change activities into a single executable project plan.
* Build and maintain detailed schedules, milestone plans, RAID logs, dependency trackers, RACI matrices, and status reporting.
* Coordinate closely with business stakeholders, IT and engineering teams, systems integrators, and vendor partners to ensure alignment on scope, timing, deliverables, and decisions.
* Facilitate planning, requirements, design, and workstream checkpoint sessions with technical leads and business process owners.
* Support governance routines, including workstream meetings, status reviews, and escalation paths; help prepare materials for steering committees and leadership updates.
* Identify, track, and escalate risks, issues, decisions, and dependencies through the project governance structure with urgency and clarity.
* Ensure the project schedule is actively managed and tightly driven, including follow-up on overdue actions, management of critical path items, and resolution of cross-workstream blockers.
* Coordinate technical and non-technical delivery activities across integrations, infrastructure, data migration, testing, cutover, and deployment, without acting as the technical authority for solution design.
* Support budget tracking, forecast updates, and variance reporting where applicable.
* Lead preparation for SIT, UAT, cutover, and go-live readiness activities in partnership with the appropriate SMEs and delivery leads.
* Support organizational change management, communications, training coordination, and adoption planning with business and OCM partners.
* Track vendor and systems integrator delivery performance against plans and milestones.
* Prepare clear status updates, decision summaries, and risk reports for project leadership.

**Required qualifications:**

* 3+ years of project management experience, including 2+ years leading technology implementation or integration projects.
* Demonstrated experience managing technical programs (e.g., software platform implementations, infrastructure or cloud migrations, system integrations, or enterprise application rollouts).
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously while maintaining a tightly controlled integrated schedule and clear accountability across teams.
* Solid understanding of technology delivery lifecycles, including planning, design, build, test, data migration, cutover, go-live, and stabilization.
* Ability to understand technical concepts, integration dependencies, environment readiness, data migration risks, and testing implications sufficiently to coordinate teams and drive delivery, without being the primary technical resource.
* Strong command of project management fundamentals including scope management, schedule management, RAID management, dependency tracking, status reporting, and governance.
* Experience working with stakeholders across business, IT, and vendor organizations.
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and organizational skills, with the ability to drive action and elevate issues clearly and promptly.
* CAPM, PMP, or equivalent certification is a plus.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience within a PMO or technology delivery team supporting cross-functional programs.
* Experience managing technical workstreams across domains such as cloud infrastructure, data & analytics, DevOps/engineering, cybersecurity, or digital/customer platforms.
* Background in technology transformation, including migration from legacy platforms and coordination of business process change.
* Exposure to enterprise governance practices, such as steering committee reporting and structured escalation management.
* Familiarity with organizational change management frameworks and enterprise adoption planning.
* Prior experience as a business analyst, technical lead, or systems power user is helpful, particularly where that experience improves communication with technical and business teams.

Overview:

GitHub is seeking an experienced and customer-focused Senior Program Manager-Incident Coordinator to independently coordinate complex, high-risk and business-critical customer situations within the Incident Coordination team’s remit.

Senior Program Manager-Incident Coordinator provides leadership during urgent customer-impacting incidents, creating clarity in ambiguous situations, establishing ownership and aligning Support, Engineering, Product, Customer Reliability Engineering, Customer Success and other stakeholders around a clear path forward.

This role requires excellent judgement, composure and the ability to influence without direct authority. The Senior Program Manager-Incident Coordinator must be able to manage several competing workstreams, make explicit prioritization decisions and communicate complex technical situations clearly to customers, senior leaders and technical stakeholders.

The role extends beyond coordinating individual incidents. Senior Program Manager-Incident Coordinators use evidence from incidents and escalations to identify recurring risks, recommend improvements and deliver agreed changes within the incident coordination remit. They partner with accountable teams on broader product, support-process and customer-experience improvements.

Success is measured through effective incident coordination, sound prioritisation, timely and accurate customer communication, reliable handovers and follow-through on agreed actions. The role also contributes to shared improvements that reduce repeat customer impact, avoidable urgent demand and preventable executive escalations.

Strategic incident leadership

* Establish clear technical ownership and coordinate workstreams, decisions, risks, dependencies and next steps. Engineering and Support remain accountable for technical decisions, remediation and resource commitments.

* Make competing priorities and trade-offs explicit, engaging specialist support or accountable leaders when needed.

Cross-functional leadership and influence

* Bring together the required internal teams and Microsoft partners to coordinate an effective response.

* Align stakeholders with different priorities, responsibilities and perspectives.

* Influence technical owners, senior stakeholders and partners without relying on direct authority.

* Resolve unclear ownership, identify alternative paths and escalate proportionately while maintaining productive relationships.

* Drive timely decisions, confirm accountable owners and track actions, risks and dependencies to completion.

* Act as a trusted operational adviser during executive-visible and high-pressure situations.

Customer and executive communication

* Translate complex technical information into concise, accurate and business-relevant updates.

* Separate confirmed facts from hypotheses, risks and unknowns.

* Set an effective communication cadence and tailor detail to each audience.

* Avoid speculation, unsupported recovery estimates and unrealistic commitments.

* Provide coordination and clarity on customer calls, managing expectations and supporting de-escalation.

* Lead difficult conversations while balancing customer advocacy with technical and operational constraints.

* Maintain stakeholder confidence while protecting responders from unnecessary distraction.

Incident intelligence and repeat-failure reduction

* Identify recurring patterns and systemic risks across incidents, customers, products and processes.

* Use evidence to define clear problems, insights and recommendations.

* Lead post-incident reviews focused on ownership, prevention and operational improvement.

* Agree corrective and preventative actions, owners and expected outcomes with accountable teams.

* Track significant actions to completion, acceptance or formal disposition, escalating stalled or unowned risks.

* Evaluate whether improvements reduce repeat incidents, customer impact and avoidable escalations.

Organisational and operational improvement

* Lead incident-coordination improvement projects and partner with accountable teams to implement agreed changes.

* Use incident and customer-impact evidence to influence product, engineering and operational priorities.

* Improve coordination processes, tooling, ownership, communication, handovers and disengagement practices.

* Identify automation and AI opportunities that increase consistency, effectiveness and scale.

* Develop outcome measures that show customer impact, operational risk and improvement progress.

* Create reusable operating practices, clarify ownership and share learning with partner teams.

Capability building

* Build and apply expertise across incident workflows and relevant product areas to clarify customer impact and support investigation.

* Train and onboard coordinators, sharing judgement and learning from complex incidents.

* Review incident communications, handovers and escalations to improve quality and consistency.

* Create reusable playbooks, standards and guidance that strengthen team capability without creating dependency on individuals.

The ideal candidate has led Quote-to-Cash transformation and scaling programs at a SaaS company and brings a clear point of view on how to deliver them.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

**Program Leadership & Governance**
-----------------------------------

* Lead the most complex cross-functional Q2I and go-to-market programs end to end, with minimal direction. Understand the Q2I process, work with key decision makers, and set the plan, scope, schedule, resources and success measures.
* Establish program governance: operating cadence, decision forums, steering committee reviews, risk and issue management, and scope control. Define decision gates for each program, including follow-on gates and resourcing for programs without a fixed end date.
* Partner with the Global Process team to maintain consistent program guides, operational plans and checklists.

### **Program Delivery & Execution**

* Own the program plan and cross-functional deliverables from intake and scoping through design, build, testing, launch and stabilization. Process and functional owners define the hypothesis, to-be process and requirements; you drive the team to deliver them. Set an owner, acceptance criteria and due date for every deliverable, run business and technical solution reviews, and escalate gaps early.
* Manage dependencies, scope and risk across Sales,Operations, Finance, Revenue, Renewals, Legal, Product, Support, Channel and IT. Coordinate the release calendar and system changes.
* Lead business readiness and go-live. Confirm each function is ready before launch, run cutover and the support period after launch, and hand off to a named owner.
* Align with Internal Audit on SOX compliance. Identify control impacts early, confirm control design, testing and evidence are complete, and keep documentation audit-ready.
* Own results after launch. Define success measures up front and ensure dashboards/KPIs are built and ready for performance reviews.

### **Change Management, Communication & AI**

* Lead change management and communication for your programs. Assess the impact on each team, plan stakeholder communication, and drive adoption. Brief executives on status, risk and decisions in clear, concise terms, and run milestone reviews and touch points.
* Use generative AI hands-on to produce program documentation, analyze risk and prepare executive reporting, and guide the team in using it responsibly. Evaluate and help deliver AI-enabled quoting and order workflows, such as AI quoting assistants, agentic workflows and AI-assisted testing, with clear success measures.

* Established program management experience with global, cross-functional teams, including leading complex, multi-quarter business transformations across Sales, Finance, Revenue, Renewals, Legal and IT.
* Working knowledge of CRM and ERP tools such as Salesforce and NetSuite.
* Hands-on experience using generative AI tools (for example Claude, Gemini or ChatGPT) in program work, such as documentation, risk analysis and executive reporting.
* Experience managing stakeholders at multiple levels, including senior leaders, with excellent verbal and written communication.
* Proficiency with agile and hybrid delivery.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience with consumption or usage-based licensing models.
* Bachelor's degree in business, information technology or a related field. A master's degree is a plus.
* Program management certification.

**About the Role**
  
We seek a hands-on, customer-facing Senior Technical Project Manager to own complex enterprise website implementations from discovery through launch. This individual connects customer business objectives, executive stakeholders, creative and technical delivery teams, and measurable outcomes. The role requires practical website-building expertise and proven enterprise stakeholder management—not deep programming specialization or immediate people-management responsibility. Prior leadership experience and potential to scale into a broader leadership role are valued.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own end-to-end enterprise website and digital experience delivery: discovery, requirements, solution alignment, planning, design/build coordination, integrations, QA/UAT, launch readiness, go-live, and customer handoff.
* Lead customer-facing workshops, governance meetings, executive updates, and escalations; align customer sponsors, business owners, IT teams, vendors, and internal Engineering, Product, Design, and Customer Success stakeholders.
* Translate customer business goals into scoped deliverables, acceptance criteria, success plans, KPIs, and measurable business outcomes; actively manage expectations, decisions, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs.
* Manage project scope, SOWs, schedules, milestones, resources, RAID logs, change requests, issue resolution, quality gates, launch risks, and delivery economics; maintain accurate project reporting.
* Bring strong practical understanding of how enterprise websites are designed, built, integrated, tested, launched, and operated; coordinate technical specialists to resolve CMS, API, analytics, SEO, Local, Schema, performance, and security dependencies.
* Contribute directly to pre-sales discovery, customer proposals, RFP responses, solution scoping and estimates; connect proposed solutions to enterprise customer business outcomes and implementation feasibility.
* Maintain accurate project dashboards and customer communication; improve delivery predictability, implementation efficiency, time to value, project profitability, and handoff readiness through disciplined execution.
  

**Success Measures / KPIs:**

* TTV (Time to Value) - Lead kickoff/discovery, implementation planning, dependency resolution, and customer cadence to shorten the time from engagement to realized value.

* TTO (Time to Onboard) and FTV (First Time to Value) - Accelerate onboarding velocity, remove blockers, and guide customers to their first measurable value milestone.

* Full Order Live - Coordinate contracted delivery across all purchased solution streams; orchestrate Milestone resources and dependencies until the complete order is live.

* Implementation CSAT - Own customer implementation satisfaction through proactive communication, routine customer/technical discussions, clear expectation-setting, and involving specialists only when needed.

* Website Health at Launch - Own QA/UAT coordination, acceptance criteria, launch readiness, go-live validation, defect closure, and stabilization against agreed website health standards.

**Required Experience & Qualifications:**

* 10+ years of experience in customer-facing Senior Technical Project Management.
* Hands-on experience managing enterprise website builds or digital agency/platform implementations from start to finish; proven ownership of large, complex customer projects.
* Demonstrated stakeholder management across enterprise customer executives, business leaders, technical teams, and external partners; ability to align diverse groups around business outcomes.
* Strong understanding of website delivery, CMS platforms, integrations, web production workflows, testing, launch, analytics, and digital marketing dependencies; able to ask the right technical questions and engage specialists.
* Experience with project/program delivery disciplines, SOWs, requirements, planning, risk management, change control, delivery profitability, executive reporting, customer-facing issue resolution, and structured handoffs.
* Demonstrated participation in pre-sales discovery, proposals, and RFP responses; excellent executive communication, facilitation, negotiation, commercial judgment, and customer-centric problem solving. Prior leadership experience and potential to grow into team leadership, without immediate direct-report or coaching expectations.

**Preferred:**
  
Agency or enterprise SaaS experience and familiarity with SEO, Local, Schema, and project tracking platforms are helpful. Ability to coordinate specialists matters more than hands-on JavaScript, API tooling, or infrastructure administration. Coding proficiency is not required.

  

**What We Offer:**
  
An opportunity to deliver high-impact enterprise digital experiences, partner with customer executives and cross-functional teams, and grow into broader leadership responsibilities based on demonstrated performance. Compensation and benefits aligned with company policy.

**How to Apply:**
  
Submit a resume highlighting end-to-end enterprise website launches, executive stakeholder alignment, customer outcomes, and quantifiable delivery improvements.

jobs.description:
Smart Tech Contracting delivers turnkey BAS & EPMS solutions for mission-critical colocation and hyperscale data centers operating at national program scale. As a Master Systems Integrator (MSI), we unify controls construction (DDC, PLC, SCADA) with software engineering, optimized graphics / UI standards, and program-level governance.

Complex integrations are delivered cleanly, consistently, and fast. Our teams thrive in high-stakes environments where quality control and uptime matters, schedules are compressed, and coordination is everything.

**Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.**

**Position Title:** Information Security Manager

**Position Location:** Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States - Dallas, TX OR Austin, TX preferred

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Information Security Manager leads Smart Tech Contracting’s information security program as the company scales from a small specialty contractor into a midsize, technology-driven organization. The role spans every STC technology function, including cloud and infrastructure, software development, AI and data services, and field operations, and represents STC’s security posture to clients, auditors, and partner organizations. STC is growing rapidly across a fully remote national workforce, and there is no internal security team today; this role builds the program and the team that runs it.

STC software developers, field engineers, and field technicians program controllers on client sites, connect to client networks, and build software and AI-enabled tools for internal use and for clients. The Information Security Manager is an enabler of that work, not a gatekeeper. Success is measured by how much faster staff can move safely: routine access approved in minutes or hours, admin rights granted through secure self-service rather than a ticket queue, new tools reviewed in days rather than weeks, and client security questionnaires answered accurately with evidence behind every answer. Policies are co-created with the teams who follow them, so the secure path is also the easiest path.

This role bridges technical security operations and business-level governance. The Information Security Manager operates with substantial autonomy and runs the security program day to day, stays hands-on with the Microsoft security stack, measures whether controls actually work, and builds the security team as STC grows.

This role is NOT responsible for AI strategy or AI tool selection. Special Projects & Innovation (SPI) and the AI Program Manager own AI tool decisions; this role reviews the security and data handling of tools SPI has vetted, quickly and with clear conditions. This role is also not the administrator of STC’s cloud platforms: the Cloud Architecture Manager builds and operates Azure, Microsoft 365, and Entra ID, while the Information Security Manager sets their security requirements and verifies the controls work. Security design of the control systems STC delivers to clients sits with STC’s engineering departments; this role defines how STC staff and devices connect to client operational technology.

The Information Security Manager reports to the IT Director and works closely with the Cloud Architecture Manager, STC’s software development teams, SPI and the AI Program Manager, department and field leaders, and STC’s managed service provider (MSP) and security partners.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

**Security Program Leadership and Strategy (15%)**

* Define and execute STC’s information security strategy and roadmap in alignment with business objectives, the annual IT plan, and leadership’s risk tolerance.
* Build, lead, and develop the security team across governance, risk, compliance, identity, and technical security disciplines, within the IT headcount plan.
* Establish and chair the Information Security Committee, setting the agenda, driving decisions, and ensuring cross-functional alignment.
* Manage security vendor relationships, including managed detection and response (MDR), vulnerability management, and tooling partners, and own the security program budget within the IT budget.
* Report on security posture, risk, control effectiveness, and program maturity to the IT Director and senior leadership on a regular cadence.

**Field and Builder Enablement (20%)**

* Work proactively with software developers, field engineers, field technicians, SPI, and department leaders to understand how they work and co-create policies that are secure and let them move faster.
* Replace waits for admin access with secure self-service options, including just-in-time or time-limited elevation, pre-approved software catalogs, and approved settings staff can apply themselves.
* Establish field-ready device and endpoint standards that support controls work on client sites, including engineering and programming software, controller connections, and access to client networks.
* Define the security controls for how STC staff, devices, and remote connections reach client operational technology, aligned with ISA / IEC 62443, without disrupting field work.
* Define tiered review paths and time-boxed exceptions so routine requests are approved in minutes or hours and higher-risk requests in days; track wait times and continuously remove blockers.

**Governance, Risk, and Compliance (25%)**

* Maintain STC’s security policies and standards within the IT policy framework the IT Director owns, aligned to NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and CIS Benchmarks, and present them to the Information Security Committee for review and approval.
* Lead SOC 2 readiness and attestation, including scope, control mapping, evidence collection, and auditor engagement.
* Maintain and mature the security risk register, conducting periodic risk assessments and ensuring risk acceptance decisions are documented and reviewed.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for client security questionnaires

jobs.description:
Smart Tech Contracting delivers turnkey BAS & EPMS solutions for mission-critical colocation and hyperscale data centers operating at national program scale. As a Master Systems Integrator (MSI), we unify controls construction (DDC, PLC, SCADA) with software engineering, optimized graphics / UI standards, and program-level governance.

Complex integrations are delivered cleanly, consistently, and fast. Our teams thrive in high-stakes environments where quality control and uptime matters, schedules are compressed, and coordination is everything.

**Join us and be part of a team where your voice matters, your work makes an impact, and your growth is a shared priority.**

**Position Title:** Information Security Manager

**Position Location:** Remote - work virtually from anywhere in the United States - Dallas, TX OR Austin, TX preferred

**JOB SUMMARY**

The Information Security Manager leads Smart Tech Contracting’s information security program as the company scales from a small specialty contractor into a midsize, technology-driven organization. The role spans every STC technology function, including cloud and infrastructure, software development, AI and data services, and field operations, and represents STC’s security posture to clients, auditors, and partner organizations. STC is growing rapidly across a fully remote national workforce, and there is no internal security team today; this role builds the program and the team that runs it.

STC software developers, field engineers, and field technicians program controllers on client sites, connect to client networks, and build software and AI-enabled tools for internal use and for clients. The Information Security Manager is an enabler of that work, not a gatekeeper. Success is measured by how much faster staff can move safely: routine access approved in minutes or hours, admin rights granted through secure self-service rather than a ticket queue, new tools reviewed in days rather than weeks, and client security questionnaires answered accurately with evidence behind every answer. Policies are co-created with the teams who follow them, so the secure path is also the easiest path.

This role bridges technical security operations and business-level governance. The Information Security Manager operates with substantial autonomy and runs the security program day to day, stays hands-on with the Microsoft security stack, measures whether controls actually work, and builds the security team as STC grows.

This role is NOT responsible for AI strategy or AI tool selection. Special Projects & Innovation (SPI) and the AI Program Manager own AI tool decisions; this role reviews the security and data handling of tools SPI has vetted, quickly and with clear conditions. This role is also not the administrator of STC’s cloud platforms: the Cloud Architecture Manager builds and operates Azure, Microsoft 365, and Entra ID, while the Information Security Manager sets their security requirements and verifies the controls work. Security design of the control systems STC delivers to clients sits with STC’s engineering departments; this role defines how STC staff and devices connect to client operational technology.

The Information Security Manager reports to the IT Director and works closely with the Cloud Architecture Manager, STC’s software development teams, SPI and the AI Program Manager, department and field leaders, and STC’s managed service provider (MSP) and security partners.

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS**

**Security Program Leadership and Strategy (15%)**

* Define and execute STC’s information security strategy and roadmap in alignment with business objectives, the annual IT plan, and leadership’s risk tolerance.
* Build, lead, and develop the security team across governance, risk, compliance, identity, and technical security disciplines, within the IT headcount plan.
* Establish and chair the Information Security Committee, setting the agenda, driving decisions, and ensuring cross-functional alignment.
* Manage security vendor relationships, including managed detection and response (MDR), vulnerability management, and tooling partners, and own the security program budget within the IT budget.
* Report on security posture, risk, control effectiveness, and program maturity to the IT Director and senior leadership on a regular cadence.

**Field and Builder Enablement (20%)**

* Work proactively with software developers, field engineers, field technicians, SPI, and department leaders to understand how they work and co-create policies that are secure and let them move faster.
* Replace waits for admin access with secure self-service options, including just-in-time or time-limited elevation, pre-approved software catalogs, and approved settings staff can apply themselves.
* Establish field-ready device and endpoint standards that support controls work on client sites, including engineering and programming software, controller connections, and access to client networks.
* Define the security controls for how STC staff, devices, and remote connections reach client operational technology, aligned with ISA / IEC 62443, without disrupting field work.
* Define tiered review paths and time-boxed exceptions so routine requests are approved in minutes or hours and higher-risk requests in days; track wait times and continuously remove blockers.

**Governance, Risk, and Compliance (25%)**

* Maintain STC’s security policies and standards within the IT policy framework the IT Director owns, aligned to NIST CSF, ISO 27001, SOC 2, and CIS Benchmarks, and present them to the Information Security Committee for review and approval.
* Lead SOC 2 readiness and attestation, including scope, control mapping, evidence collection, and auditor engagement.
* Maintain and mature the security risk register, conducting periodic risk assessments and ensuring risk acceptance decisions are documented and reviewed.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for client security questionnaires

jobs.description:
**POSITION TITLE:** Associate Security Analyst

**Supervised by:** Manager, Information Security (Direct)

**Supervises:** N/A

**FLSA Status:** Non-Exempt

**POSITION SUMMARY.** MediQuant helps more than 250 health systems and hospital networks retire, secure, and modernize their legacy healthcare data. As an Associate IT Security Analyst, you’ll help answer that question: completing the security assessments hospital customers rely on when they choose us, while building hands-on skills in alert triage, vulnerability management, and incident response in a real production healthcare environment. It is an unusually broad start in security, with a clear path toward IT Security Analyst.

Entry-level member of MediQuant’s security team who supports customer and vendor security assurance, day-to-day security operations, and audit readiness. Time is split roughly evenly between customer and vendor security assurance and security operations. Works under the guidance of senior team members and the Information Security Manager and builds technical skills and healthcare compliance knowledge over time.

**JOB DUTIES and ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS.** A qualified individual must be able to perform these essential functions of the job as listed, with or without accommodation.

* **Customer & Third-Party Security Assurance**
  + Complete and track customer and prospect security questionnaires, RFPs, and RFIs (HITRUST-, HIPAA-, and NIST-based) within agreed turnaround times, working with IT, Infrastructure, Legal, Sales, and Customer Success experts to get accurate answers.
  + Maintain the library of approved responses and supporting evidence: check answers for accuracy, consistency, and clarity, update it from submitted-assessment feedback, and retire outdated or conflicting content.
  + Verify before you submit: confirm each answer reflects a control that is actually in place through evidence or a direct check, not recollection or intent and hold anything unverified for the Information Security Manager.
  + Support vendor risk reviews for new and renewing vendors: collect and review SOC 2 and HITRUST reports, Business Associate Agreements, and vendor questionnaires; flag contract concerns (audit rights, insurance, SLAs) to the Information Security Manager.
  + Track vendor and customer findings, open remediation items, and renewal dates; follow up with internal relationship owners on outstanding items; and keep vendor-management documents current against HITRUST CSF requirements.
* **Security Monitoring & Incident Response**
  + Monitor and triage alerts from SIEM, endpoint protection, email security, and other defense tools; perform initial investigation, collect artifacts, and document findings in the ticketing system.
  + Escalate confirmed or suspected incidents promptly, per the Incident Response plan, to senior security team members or the Information Security Manager.
  + Document systems and data involved, timeline, and actions taken accurately enough for the Information Security Manager to make HIPAA breach determinations and notifications.
  + Watch threat advisories for items that may affect MediQuant; assist with post-incident reviews and runbook updates.
* **Vulnerability & Endpoint Security**
  + Run scheduled vulnerability scans, review results, and track remediation to closure.
  + Independently verify remediation (for example, by rescanning or directly checking the system) rather than relying on owner-reported status; document exceptions for senior review.
  + Monitor EDR agent health and deployment coverage and produce routine reports.
* **Compliance, Audit & Policy Support**
  + Collect, organize, and maintain evidence for HIPAA, HITRUST r2, and client or contractual requirements; assist with internal and external audits and track findings and corrective actions.
  + Support the policy review cycle: track review dates, gather stakeholder feedback, draft proposed updates, and maintain version history for Information Security Manager approval; use the control crosswalk to check policy references (HITRUST CSF, HIPAA, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53) and flag gaps.
* **Ways of Working & Growth**
  + Escalate early: tell the Information Security Manager about at-risk deadlines, stalled remediation, or unresolved vendor or customer issues before they slip, not after, and bring a proposed next step when you can.
  + Write and maintain knowledge articles, procedures, and runbooks; recommend improvements to questionnaire, vendor-review, and monitoring workflows.
  + Assist with the security awareness program, including phishing campaign setup, monitoring, and reporting.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Competencies:**

* Attention to Detail & Accuracy
* Written Communication
* Initiative & Accountability
* Critical Thinking & Basic Risk Analysis
* Collaboration & Customer Service
* Time Management
* Process Improvement
* Continuous Learning

**Required Education and Experience:**

* Associate degree or certificates in a computer-related field, or equivalent experience (internships, lab work, help desk, or military service).
* 0–1 years in an IT security, IT support, or related technical role.
* Clear written communication, including technical documentation experience (coursework and internships count): you can write an accurate, plain-English answer to a technical or compliance question.
* Foundational knowledge of security monitoring, vulnerability management, and network security concepts, and reliable follow-through on deadlines.

**Work Environment.** Employees may work from our corporate headquarters or work from home. Employees may at times be required to travel to headquarters for meetings or company events. Remote workers will be provided with a company laptop and are responsible for maintaining access to high-speed internet.

**Physical Demands.** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to sit for long periods of time,

You'll bring the rigor that ties it all together by pulling every team's data into one place, pressure-testing it, and turning it into insight leadership can act on. * Maintain channel P&Ls and track margin and unit economics, including CAC, LTV, and contribution margin, by channel and SKU
* Partner with Growth on performance marketing budget and pacing
* Pressure-test assumptions and turn analysis into clear recommendations for the CFO and leadership

**What You'll Bring:**

jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY:**

The Partner Operations Analyst is the entry point into CFSB’s partner technical operations team, responsible for first-line triage of inbound partner requests and for day-to-day monitoring of file-based production movement. As CFSB centralizes partner support into a single intake and ticketing workflow, this role receives, categorizes, and routes incoming partner issues — operational, technical, or otherwise — to the correct owner, and owns confirmation and monitoring of file delivery through our secure file transfer tool, verifying whether files from partners and vendors were sent, received, and landed as expected. This is a high-visibility, detail-driven role for someone early in their career who wants to grow into partner integration and platform engineering.

**Responsibilities:**

* Serve as first-line triage for the centralized partner support workflow: receive inbound partner requests through the single intake channel (shared inbox, ticketing, or portal), categorize them by type and urgency, and route or escalate to the correct internal owner using defined procedures.
* Monitor and confirm file-based production movement through our secure file transfer tool: verify whether expected files from partners and vendors were sent, received, and landed, and proactively flag missing, late, or failed transfers.
* Provide first-line production support for file-movement issues — perform initial triage, gather the context needed for resolution, and escalate to senior engineers with clear, complete information.
* Maintain accurate and timely ticket records and status updates so partners and internal stakeholders have clear visibility into open issues.
* Track recurring request types and transfer issues, and surface patterns that point to automation or documentation opportunities.
* Contribute to and help maintain intake procedures, routing and escalation runbooks, and file-movement monitoring checklists.
* Assist with partner-notification and campaign communications as directed, including distribution and tracking.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities:**

* Basic SQL and comfort querying data to confirm records or investigate a reported issue.
* Working familiarity with files and file-transfer concepts, and a basic understanding of APIs and HTTP (requests, responses, status codes).
* Comfort with ticketing or case-management tools and structured intake/triage workflows.
* Strong attention to detail and follow-through — this role is the safety net that catches missed files and misrouted requests before they become partner issues.
* Clear written and verbal communication; able to capture issue context accurately and keep stakeholders informed.
* Organized and dependable in routine production monitoring, with sound judgment about when to escalate.
* Eagerness to learn payment rails, and integration tooling, and to grow toward an engineering track.

**Education, Training, and Experience:**

* 1+ years in a technical support, operations, QA, or analyst role (or equivalent internship or education) involving data, files, or software systems.
* Exposure to SQL and to file-based or API-based data exchange.
* Experience with ticketing or case-management tools, or demonstrable aptitude to learn them quickly.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Exposure to managed file transfer (MOVEit or similar) or file-based data processing.
* Familiarity with payment or banking operations (ACH, wires, RTP) or fintech.
* Experience in a production-support or monitoring environment.
* Basic scripting exposure (e.g., PowerShell), or a clear interest in developing it.

**Work Schedule:**

* Primarily standard business hours. As the production-support function matures, this role may participate in an on-call rotation to cover file-movement monitoring and partner-impacting issues outside core hours.

Together with GZERO Media—the go-to source of first insight into geopolitics—and our full-fledged events team, the Eurasia Group umbrella provides a complete political risk solution.

Headquartered in New York, we have offices in Washington, London, São Paulo, Brasilia, Tokyo, Singapore, and San Francisco, as well as on-the-ground experts in more than a hundred countries in every region of the world.

We are committed to analysis that is free of political bias and the influence of private interests.

Visit us: eurasiagroup.net | gzeromedia.com

Follow us: LinkedIn | X | Threads | Facebook | Instagram | YouTube

**Position Overview**

We are seeking a **mid-level** technically skilled and hands-on Business Intelligence and Data Analytics Specialist to join our global team, supporting executive leadership in understanding and advancing Eurasia Group’s business performance. This position is ideal for a data-driven professional seeking a focused analytics role at the heart of a growing, dynamic business. You will collect, organize, analyze, and present complex business data—guiding decisions on sales, profitability, client engagement, research capacity, and overall corporate strategy.

**Responsibilities**

* Serve as technical lead and primary steward of EG's business intelligence systems, managing the full backend-to-dashboard data flow.
* Gather, integrate, validate, and organize raw data from sources including finance, sales, research readership, and client engagement, using Excel, PowerBI, Salesforce, and relational databases (including SQL). Proactively identify and lead improvements in BI infrastructure to scale with business needs.
* Connect and integrate multiple data sources across the business, ensuring data quality, consistency, and accessibility.
* Lead strategic data driven projects by collaborating closely with finance, operations, and research leaders.
* Lead the preparation and data analysis underlying business performance presentations for the CEO and senior leadership.
* Own data uptime and monitoring of data pipelines, ensuring daily report refreshes run smoothly and without disruption.
* Distill and communicate actionable business insights to non-technical audiences, ensuring clarity and credibility in all presentations and data tools.
* Support innovative data and PowerBI initiatives, such as a political risk dashboard tool, as a contributor to the firm’s ongoing research/data innovation efforts.

**Qualifications**

* **At least 5 years of hands-on professional experience** in business analytics, consulting, research, corporate strategy, data analysis, or related field.
* Bachelor’s degree required; preferred fields include business, statistics, economics, mathematics, engineering, computer science, or related discipline. Advanced degrees are a plus.
* Prior work supporting business analytics in research, consulting, or professional services environments strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience building and managing data dashboards for executive audiences; Proficiency in Excel (advanced), SQL, Salesforce (strongly preferred), & PowerBI. Experience with ETL, DBT, or other modern data tools a plus.
* Direct experience collecting and cleaning large and sometimes messy datasets; proven ability to present findings clearly to non-technical audiences.
* Curiosity, tenacity, intellectual rigor, high degree of organization, keen attention to detail, and ability to exercise discretion.
* Excellent communication and time management skills; proven ability to work closely with senior leaders and across teams.
* Ability to operate independently within a fast-paced environment and rapidly evolving business analytics structure.
* English fluency required.
* Interest in global affairs and political risk is a plus.
* Comfortable working as the junior “doer” within a global team, engaging in hands-on data tasks in support of more senior team members.

**Career Development**  
This is an outstanding opportunity to deepen your expertise in business intelligence, data analytics, and corporate strategy within a fast-growing segment of Eurasia Group. The role is best suited to those committed to advancing in the field of business analytics and eager to grow their technical and presentation skills in a dynamic, globally connected workplace.

The applicable base salary range for this role is $90,000 to $110,000.

The base pay offered will be determined on factors such as experience, skills, training, location, certifications, and education. Decisions will be determined on a case-by-case basis.

At Eurasia Group, our mission is to provide the tools and understanding needed in a world where politics drives disruption. We put **politics first** for our clients, and we aspire to be the leading place people come to find out about the world. This requires us to maintain a company culture that puts people first. We are committed to fostering an environment that is empowering and globally minded. We firmly believe that bringing people with a variety of ideas and perspectives to the table makes our analysis stronger for our clients and creates a better workplace. Our leadership team is dedicated to embedding this approach into everything we do and how we lead because we care deeply about our work and our people.

We’re an applied AI company serving the nation’s builders, tackling one of the largest information challenges in the economy: understanding *what can be built, where, and how*. Our AI agent workforce helps the fastest-growing construction companies navigate everything from permitting and licensing to inspections and project closeouts – accelerating housing, clean-energy, and infrastructure development across the country.

PermitFlow has already delivered unprecedented speed, accuracy, and visibility to over $20B in development, helping contractors reduce compliance time, de-risk projects, and scale with confidence.

As the U.S. enters a new capex supercycle across data centers, factories, housing, and renewables, joining PermitFlow means building the AI infrastructure at the core of every construction project driving the next wave of reindustrialization.

We’ve raised over $90M, most recently completing our Series B, from top-tier investors including Accel, Kleiner Perkins, Initialized, Y Combinator, Felicis, and Altos Ventures, with backing from leaders at OpenAI, Google, Procore, ServiceTitan, Zillow, PlanGrid, and Uber.

**Our HQ is in New York City with a hybrid schedule (3 in-office days per week). We are seeking NYC-based candidates or those open to relocation to NYC.**

**About the Role**
==================

As the Senior Revenue Operations Analyst (Marketing Ops) at PermitFlow, you'll build the systems, data, and automation behind our entire demand engine, from first touch to closed revenue. You'll own how we capture, route, enrich, and measure every lead, campaign, and event. Then you'll turn that data into the insights leadership uses to decide where to invest.

This is a builder role with strategic reach. You'll build our marketing operations function from the ground up: the processes, metrics, planning cadence, and infrastructure that let pipeline generation grow with the business. You'll partner with Marketing, Sales Development, and Sales leadership, with direct visibility to the executive team.

We want someone who moves between strategy and execution in the same day, and who wants to build marketing operations at a fast-growing startup.

==================

* **Marketing Automation and CRM**: Own HubSpot as our marketing automation platform, including forms, workflows, lists, lifecycle stages, and lead source logic. Own the HubSpot and Salesforce sync so contacts, campaigns, and activity land cleanly in the CRM.
* **Inbound Funnel and Routing**: Own the path from form fill to booked meeting: enrichment, qualification, routing, and handoff to Sales Development. Track speed to lead and conversion at each step, and fix the places where leads stall.
* **Attribution and Reporting**: Build reporting that shows which channels, campaigns, and events create pipeline and revenue. Give Marketing and leadership a clear monthly view of funnel health, with recommendations, not just numbers.
* **Campaigns, Events, and Data**: Run the operations behind events and tradeshows. Build target account and prospect lists with tools like Clay and ZoomInfo. Keep account and contact data clean, deduplicated, and enriched.
* **AI and Automation**: Use AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT every day to build, analyze, document, and prototype. Design and maintain automations in n8n that connect HubSpot, Salesforce, Slack, and our data providers. Decide when to build and when to buy.

**Who You Are**
===============

* **Relevant experience**: 4+ years in marketing operations, revenue operations, or growth operations, ideally at a B2B SaaS company.
* **Marketing automation**: Hands-on admin experience in HubSpot (Marketo or Pardot also welcome), including workflows, forms, lists, and lead scoring.
* **Salesforce**: Comfortable with reports, dashboards, campaigns, and the lead and contact model. Admin experience is a plus.
* **Attribution and analytics**: You've built funnel and attribution reporting that leaders actually used. You have SQL or strong spreadsheet skills.
* **AI fluency**: You use AI tools daily to write, analyze, and build, and you check the output before it ships.
* **Automation**: Experience with n8n, Zapier, Make, or similar.
* **Startup experience**: You've helped a team move from early, manual processes to repeatable ones.
* **Collaborative partner**: You earn trust with both Marketing and Sales and can translate between them.
* **Hybrid in NYC**: In office Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.
* **Nice to have**: Clay, ZoomInfo, event and tradeshow operations, construction or vertical SaaS experience.

**What We Offer**
=================

* Competitive salary and meaningful equity in a high-growth company
* 100% company-paid base medical, dental, and vision coverage for employees + healthcare FSA
* 401(k) savings plan
* Unlimited PTO and paid family leave
* Home office & equipment stipend
* Daily in-office lunch and dinner provided
* Commuter benefits (pre-tax transit and parking)

*PermitFlow provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, or family status, as protected by applicable law.*

*We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities. All employment decisions are based on merit, qualifications, and business needs.*

Peraton is a next-generation national security company that drives missions of consequence spanning the globe and extending to the farthest reaches of the galaxy. As the world’s leading mission capability integrator and transformative enterprise IT provider, we deliver trusted, highly differentiated solutions and technologies to protect our nation and allies. Peraton operates at the critical nexus between traditional and nontraditional threats across all domains: land, sea, space, air, and cyberspace. The company serves as a valued partner to essential government agencies and supports every branch of the U.S. armed forces. Each day, our employees solve the most daunting challenges that our customers face. Visit peraton.com to learn how we’re keeping people around the world safe and secure.

##### **Program Overview**

Encompasses technical, engineering, data analytics, cyber security, management, operational, logistical, and administrative support for Bureau of Diplomatic Security, Cyber and Technology Security Directorate in three key offices/functional areas: Cyber Monitoring and Operations, Cyber Threat and Investigations, and Technology Innovation and Engineering State.

##### **About The Role**

Peraton is seeking to hire a **Sr Cyber Intel Analyst** to become a part our Indications and Warnings team with the Federal Strategic Cyber group.

  

**Location:** Arlington, VA.

  

**You'll have the opportunity to:**

  

* Leverage open-source, proprietary/vendor, and classified reporting to closely track advanced persistent threat actor activity.
* Perform pattern, trend, and behavior analysis, as well as other specialized analysis techniques to identify malicious cyber threat activity targeting DOS information, systems, and personnel.
* Maintain records to catalog and track malicious cyber threat activity targeting DOS information, systems and personnel.
* Identify Indicators of Compromise (IOCs) present on an Enterprise network through the use of a SIEM and other security tools and logs.
* Liaise with members of the Intelligence Community (IC); and Acts as the fusion analysis cell within Cyber Threat Analysis Division (CTAD).
* Provide presentations to a variety of technical and non-technical audiences pertaining to cyber threats.
* For up to 10% travel to foreign and domestic locations.

##### **Qualifications**

**Basic Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree and 9 years of experience; an additional 4 years of experience will be considered in lieu of the degree requirement.
* Must possess or be able to obtain at least one of the following certifications before start date. Continued certification required as a condition of employment: CASP+ CE; CCNP Security; CEH; CFR; CHFI; CISA; CISSP (or Associate); Cloud+; CND; CySA+;GCED; GCIH; GICSP; SSCP
* Experience with Splunk SIEM.
* Experience leveraging the MITRE ATT&CK matrix or other threat models (e.g. Lockheed Martin Kill Chain, Diamond Model).

jobs.description:
About the Position  
  
The Non-Clinical Project Manager is responsible for independently managing all aspects of project progress, fiscal control, customer service, staffing, product development and delivery of multiple research projects.
  
  
\*\*OVERNIGHTS ARE EXPECTED AT LEAST ONCE A WEEK\*\*  
  
\*\*US CITIZENSHIP IS REQUIRED FOR THIS POSITION\*\*  
  
About the Project  
  
This project is a multi-institution research collaboration with Stanford, Johns Hopkins, the Veteran Affairs (VA), and the Department of War (DoW) to build a sleep foundation model. Unlike traditional AI models, a sleep foundation model relies on self-supervised learning on vast amounts of physiological sleep study data (petabyte-level). By generating representations (embeddings) from the sleep data, the team aims to forecast future health risks and uncover latent patterns that traditional sleep scoring metrics miss.

jobs.title: Mobile Treatment Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Standard Healthcare Plus** is expanding its behavioral health services and is preparing to launch a new Mobile Treatment Program to provide community-based mental health services to individuals with significant behavioral health needs.

We are seeking an experienced, motivated, and highly organized **Mobile Treatment Program Manager** to lead the operational development and launch of this new program. This is an exciting opportunity for a hands-on leader who enjoys building programs, developing teams, establishing effective systems, and ensuring high-quality service delivery.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter who can take initiative, work independently, and translate program goals into practical operations. The successful candidate will play a key role in establishing the program infrastructure, recruiting and onboarding staff, developing operational workflows, coordinating community-based services, and ensuring the program is positioned for long-term success.

**Position Overview**

The Mobile Treatment Program Manager is responsible for overseeing the day-to-day operational coordination and development of Standard Healthcare Plus's Mobile Treatment Program. This position will work closely with agency leadership and clinical leadership to establish program operations, coordinate staffing, monitor service delivery, support regulatory compliance, and promote quality and continuity of care.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Program Development & Launch**

* Lead the operational startup and implementation of the Mobile Treatment Program.
* Develop and implement operational workflows, procedures, staffing structures, and systems in collaboration with agency leadership.
* Assist with establishing program infrastructure, including referral management, intake coordination, caseload assignments, scheduling, and service tracking.
* Identify operational needs, anticipate challenges, and develop solutions to support a successful program launch.
* Assist with establishing program goals, performance measures, and operational benchmarks.

**Staff Recruitment, Development & Management**

* Participate in recruiting, interviewing, hiring, onboarding, and training program staff.
* Build and develop a multidisciplinary team capable of delivering effective community-based services.
* Coordinate staff schedules, field assignments, caseload distribution, and service coverage.
* Provide administrative supervision, coaching, and performance feedback to assigned staff.
* Monitor staff productivity, attendance, training compliance, and documentation completion.
* Promote accountability, teamwork, and a positive organizational culture.

**Daily Program Operations**

* Oversee daily operational activities and ensure consistent service coverage.
* Monitor referrals, admissions, client engagement, caseloads, and service follow-up.
* Coordinate field visits, staff deployment, and community-based service schedules.
* Identify and address operational barriers that may affect service delivery.
* Monitor program utilization, productivity, and performance outcomes.
* Prepare regular operational reports and communicate program needs to leadership.

**Regulatory Compliance & Quality Assurance**

* Support compliance with applicable COMAR 10.63 regulations, payer requirements, contractual obligations, and CARF standards.
* Monitor documentation for accuracy, completeness, timeliness, and required signatures.
* Collaborate with clinical leadership and quality assurance personnel to maintain program readiness for audits and reviews.
* Track corrective action plans and support ongoing quality improvement initiatives.
* Ensure staff are informed of applicable operational policies, procedures, and documentation requirements.

**Field Operations & Community Partnerships**

* Establish and monitor field safety procedures, staff check-in protocols, and incident reporting processes.
* Coordinate community-based service delivery throughout Prince George's County and other designated service areas.
* Develop and maintain professional relationships with hospitals, behavioral health providers, referral sources, and community organizations.
* Support referral development, community outreach, and coordination with external partners.
* Represent Standard Healthcare Plus at designated community meetings and networking opportunities.

**Qualifications**

**Education & Experience**

* Master's degree in Social Work, Counseling, Psychology, or a related behavioral health discipline preferred.
* Three to five years of experience in behavioral health, community-based mental health, Mobile Treatment, or Assertive Community Treatment (ACT) services.
* At least two years of supervisory, management, team leadership, or program coordination experience preferred.
* Experience developing, launching, or expanding behavioral health programs is highly desirable.
* Demonstrated experience with staff recruitment, team development, operational planning, and program implementation is strongly preferred.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Working knowledge of Maryland COMAR 10.63 regulations and applicable behavioral health program requirements.
* Familiarity with CARF accreditation, quality assurance, and electronic health record systems.
* Strong leadership, organizational, communication, and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to establish operational systems, manage competing priorities, and work independently.

**Licensure**

* Active Maryland clinical licensure (LCSW-C, LCPC, or equivalent) preferred.

**Additional Requirements**

* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.

Pay: $85,000.00 - $110,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Clinton, MD 20735
