  + Complete and track customer and prospect security questionnaires, RFPs, and RFIs (HITRUST-, HIPAA-, and NIST-based) within agreed turnaround times, working with IT, Infrastructure, Legal, Sales, and Customer Success experts to get accurate answers.
  + Maintain the library of approved responses and supporting evidence: check answers for accuracy, consistency, and clarity, update it from submitted-assessment feedback, and retire outdated or conflicting content.
  + Verify before you submit: confirm each answer reflects a control that is actually in place through evidence or a direct check, not recollection or intent and hold anything unverified for the Information Security Manager.
  + Support vendor risk reviews for new and renewing vendors: collect and review SOC 2 and HITRUST reports, Business Associate Agreements, and vendor questionnaires; flag contract concerns (audit rights, insurance, SLAs) to the Information Security Manager.
  + Track vendor and customer findings, open remediation items, and renewal dates; follow up with internal relationship owners on outstanding items; and keep vendor-management documents current against HITRUST CSF requirements.
* **Security Monitoring & Incident Response**
  + Monitor and triage alerts from SIEM, endpoint protection, email security, and other defense tools; perform initial investigation, collect artifacts, and document findings in the ticketing system.
  + Escalate confirmed or suspected incidents promptly, per the Incident Response plan, to senior security team members or the Information Security Manager.
  + Document systems and data involved, timeline, and actions taken accurately enough for the Information Security Manager to make HIPAA breach determinations and notifications.
  + Watch threat advisories for items that may affect MediQuant; assist with post-incident reviews and runbook updates.
* **Vulnerability & Endpoint Security**
  + Run scheduled vulnerability scans, review results, and track remediation to closure.
  + Independently verify remediation (for example, by rescanning or directly checking the system) rather than relying on owner-reported status; document exceptions for senior review.
  + Monitor EDR agent health and deployment coverage and produce routine reports.
* **Compliance, Audit & Policy Support**
  + Collect, organize, and maintain evidence for HIPAA, HITRUST r2, and client or contractual requirements; assist with internal and external audits and track findings and corrective actions.
  + Support the policy review cycle: track review dates, gather stakeholder feedback, draft proposed updates, and maintain version history for Information Security Manager approval; use the control crosswalk to check policy references (HITRUST CSF, HIPAA, NIST CSF, NIST SP 800-53) and flag gaps.
* **Ways of Working & Growth**
  + Escalate early: tell the Information Security Manager about at-risk deadlines, stalled remediation, or unresolved vendor or customer issues before they slip, not after, and bring a proposed next step when you can.
  + Write and maintain knowledge articles, procedures, and runbooks; recommend improvements to questionnaire, vendor-review, and monitoring workflows.
  + Assist with the security awareness program, including phishing campaign setup, monitoring, and reporting.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Competencies:**

* Attention to Detail & Accuracy
* Written Communication
* Initiative & Accountability
* Critical Thinking & Basic Risk Analysis
* Collaboration & Customer Service
* Time Management
* Process Improvement
* Continuous Learning

**Required Education and Experience:**

* Associate degree or certificates in a computer-related field, or equivalent experience (internships, lab work, help desk, or military service).
* 0–1 years in an IT security, IT support, or related technical role.
* Clear written communication, including technical documentation experience (coursework and internships count): you can write an accurate, plain-English answer to a technical or compliance question.
* Foundational knowledge of security monitoring, vulnerability management, and network security concepts, and reliable follow-through on deadlines.

**Work Environment.** Employees may work from our corporate headquarters or work from home. Employees may at times be required to travel to headquarters for meetings or company events. Remote workers will be provided with a company laptop and are responsible for maintaining access to high-speed internet.

**Physical Demands.** While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear. The employee frequently is required to sit for long periods of time,

The Partner Operations Analyst is the entry point into CFSB’s partner technical operations team, responsible for first-line triage of inbound partner requests and for day-to-day monitoring of file-based production movement. As CFSB centralizes partner support into a single intake and ticketing workflow, this role receives, categorizes, and routes incoming partner issues — operational, technical, or otherwise — to the correct owner, and owns confirmation and monitoring of file delivery through our secure file transfer tool, verifying whether files from partners and vendors were sent, received, and landed as expected. **Responsibilities:**

* Track recurring request types and transfer issues, and surface patterns that point to automation or documentation opportunities.

* Assist with partner-notification and campaign communications as directed, including distribution and tracking.

* Basic SQL and comfort querying data to confirm records or investigate a reported issue.

* Comfort with ticketing or case-management tools and structured intake/triage workflows.
* Strong attention to detail and follow-through — this role is the safety net that catches missed files and misrouted requests before they become partner issues.
* Clear written and verbal communication; able to capture issue context accurately and keep stakeholders informed.

* Eagerness to learn payment rails, and integration tooling, and to grow toward an engineering track.

new_jobs.description:
About the Position  
  
The Non-Clinical Project Manager is responsible for independently managing all aspects of project progress, fiscal control, customer service, staffing, product development and delivery of multiple research projects.
  
  
\*\*OVERNIGHTS ARE EXPECTED AT LEAST ONCE A WEEK\*\*  
  
\*\*US CITIZENSHIP IS REQUIRED FOR THIS POSITION\*\*  
  
About the Project  
  
This project is a multi-institution research collaboration with Stanford, Johns Hopkins, the Veteran Affairs (VA), and the Department of War (DoW) to build a sleep foundation model. Unlike traditional AI models, a sleep foundation model relies on self-supervised learning on vast amounts of physiological sleep study data (petabyte-level). By generating representations (embeddings) from the sleep data, the team aims to forecast future health risks and uncover latent patterns that traditional sleep scoring metrics miss.

new_jobs.description:
**Optimization Engineer / Operations Research Analyst**
=======================================================

**Location:** Falls Church, VA (Onsite Requirement: Up to 60%)  
**Security Clearance:** Active Secret Clearance Required

**Salary:** $125,000 - $150,000

**About the Opportunity**
-------------------------

3 Reasons Consulting (3RC) is seeking an experienced **Optimization Engineer / Operations Research Analyst** to support a federal analytics initiative focused on solving complex resource-allocation and operational planning challenges.

In this role, you will apply mathematical optimization and operations research techniques to help federal decision makers identify the best possible courses of action within complex operational constraints. You will formulate, develop, and implement advanced optimization models that complement statistical simulation and AI-driven analytics, transforming competing priorities and resource limitations into actionable recommendations.

Working alongside data scientists, AI engineers, technical architects, and operational subject matter experts, you will help build a production-ready decision-support capability within the Palantir Foundry ecosystem.

This is an opportunity for an analytical problem-solver who enjoys tackling complex challenges through mathematical modeling, algorithm development, and practical engineering solutions.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Develop Optimization Models:** Formulate real-world resource-allocation, workforce planning, and scheduling challenges as linear programming and mixed-integer optimization models.
* **Build Optimization Solvers:** Design, develop, and maintain optimization solvers that integrate with a broader analytics and decision-support platform.
* **Translate Operational Requirements:** Partner with subject matter experts to define, refine, and validate model constraints, ensuring solutions reflect real-world operational requirements and limitations.
* **Evaluate Courses of Action:** Develop models that identify optimal resource-allocation strategies while balancing competing priorities, operational requirements, and capacity constraints.
* **Validate Model Performance:** Benchmark optimization outputs against statistical simulation and AI-based modeling approaches to support cross-validation and improve analytical confidence.
* **Collaborate with Stakeholders:** Review model results with technical teams and operational stakeholders, explain analytical outcomes, and refine solutions based on mission needs.
* **Support Production Integration:** Develop efficient, maintainable Python code to integrate optimization models and solvers into production analytics applications.

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* **Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related discipline. Equivalent practical experience may be substituted with an additional four years of relevant hands-on experience.**
* **6+ years' experience with operations research or optimization engineering.**
* 4+ years of professional experience in linear programming, mixed-integer programming, or constraint-based optimization.

  Hands-on experience with optimization solvers and frameworks such as CPLEX, Gurobi, Google OR-Tools, or comparable technologies.
* Strong proficiency in Python, including experience integrating optimization models into software applications or production systems.
* Demonstrated ability to translate complex operational challenges into mathematical formulations and practical optimization solutions.
* **Active Secret security clearance.**

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience applying operations research and mathematical optimization within defense, healthcare, logistics, workforce planning, or scheduling environments.
* Familiarity with statistical simulation, predictive modeling, or agent-based modeling techniques.
* Experience with Palantir Foundry, including its native optimization and decision-support capabilities.
* Experience collaborating with multidisciplinary engineering, data science, and operational teams.
* Familiarity with integrating optimization models into cloud-based analytics platforms.

**Why Join 3RC?**
-----------------

At 3 Reasons Consulting, we bring together talented professionals to deliver innovative solutions to meaningful government and defense missions. We value technical excellence, collaboration, accountability, and the ability to turn complex challenges into practical results.

If you're passionate about operations research, mathematical optimization, and solving real-world resource-allocation problems, we'd like to hear from you.

**Solve complex challenges. Optimize mission outcomes. Make an impact with 3RC.**

**Benefits at 3 Reasons Consulting:**

**Company-Paid Benefits:**

* Short/Long Term Disability

* Leave Accrual
* Holidays
* 401(k) Match

**Employee / Company Shared Benefits:**

* Additional (Voluntary) Life Insurance

* Medical Coverage
* Dental Coverage
* Vision Care Plan
* Flexible Spending Account Plan

**An Equal Opportunity Employer**

3 Reasons Consulting is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to providing a workplace free from discrimination or harassment and hold all 3 Reasons employees accountable to protect this mission.  
We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, military status, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. All applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to protected bases.

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.

All U.S. Citizens. The position(s) will be filled through a direct-hire authority.

Together with GZERO Media—the go-to source of first insight into geopolitics—and our full-fledged events team, the Eurasia Group umbrella provides a complete political risk solution.

The Project Manager (Technical) is a key delivery role within the PCE Office at Safran Electrical & Power UK. Rather than being permanently assigned to a single programme, PMs (Technical) are deployed flexibly across the portfolio by the Engineering Acceleration Manager — directed to where they are most needed at any given time, whether that is supporting an active development programme, managing a legacy or historic programme through to close-out, or contributing to PCE Office improvement initiatives.

Tasked by the Senior Project Manager (SPM) of the assigned programme, the PM (Technical) takes ownership of defined Work Packages and is responsible for ensuring delivery within Quality, Cost, and Schedule (QCD) objectives. They serve as a core member of the Integrated Project Team (IPT), coordinating day-to-day project activities, managing risks, tracking actions, and maintaining project data in Safran’s project management tools.

* Establish and maintain the project baseline; trace all change requests against it and identify scope, cost, and schedule deviations clearly and promptly.

**Who are Eque2**

At Eque2, we create specialist software that helps construction and housebuilding businesses work smarter.

Our solutions support everything from estimating and financial management to commercial operations and project delivery. Working with platforms including Microsoft, Sage and Xero, we support over 3,000 businesses across the UK and Ireland.

We’re a growing business with ambitious plans, and we’re always looking for talented people who want to be part of what comes next.

**About the Role**

Eque2 is seeking a hands-on AI Implementation Manager to accelerate AI adoption and turn opportunities into measurable business outcomes. This role could suit a high-potential graduate, early-career technologist or career changer who can demonstrate strong practical capability. It combines business analysis, process improvement, rapid prototyping and AI implementation.

You will work across functions to discover opportunities, understand requirements, redesign workflows, rapidly prototype solutions, build and deploy AI agents and automations, support adoption and measure realised value. You should be comfortable learning from executives, technical colleagues and frontline teams, and using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Power Platform, Vibe Coding tools and related AI technologies to turn ideas into working solutions.

This is not a traditional project management, change management or data science role. It is an implementation role for someone who can move from ambiguity and business need through to a working, governed and adopted solution. You will help Eque2 move from isolated experimentation to repeatable, operationalised AI delivery while supporting the AI Centre of Excellence and Champion Network.

**Is this role for you?**

This role could be for you if you’re curious about AI, enjoy solving problems and like turning ideas into practical solutions. You may be a graduate, early in your career or moving from another discipline. What matters most is your ability to demonstrate practical capability, learn quickly and take ownership.

You’ll enjoy experimenting, building and improving solutions, but you’ll also understand that successful AI implementation is about more than the technology. You’ll be interested in how people, processes, data, controls and adoption all contribute to delivering real business value.

**Key Responsibilities**

**AI Opportunity Discovery**

* Engage teams across Eque2 to understand business challenges, processes, decisions and opportunities.
* Plan and facilitate structured AI discovery workshops.
* Identify pain points, bottlenecks, repetitive work and avoidable friction.
* Assess and prioritise use cases based on value, feasibility, readiness, risk and reuse potential.
* Translate business needs into clear implementation plans and measurable outcomes.

**AI Solution Design and Build**

* Design, build, test and deploy AI agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio.
* Use Vibe Coding and AI-assisted development tools to turn natural-language requirements into prototypes, applications, scripts and workflow solutions.
* Develop copilots, agents and workflow automations integrated with Microsoft 365 and relevant business systems.
* Configure prompts, instructions, knowledge sources, actions, workflows, connectors and integrations.
* Prototype rapidly to test user need, technical feasibility and expected value before scaling.
* Review, test and improve AI-generated code, escalating security, architecture or integration risks where specialist support is needed.
* Produce proportionate solution documentation and handover materials.
* Work with internal technical teams and specialist partners where deeper architecture, integration or engineering is required.

**Business Analysis and Process Transformation**

* Analyse current processes, workflows, controls, information flows and decision points.
* Redesign work so that AI augments people, removes friction and releases capacity for higher-value activity.
* Gather and document functional and non-functional requirements.
* Produce use cases, process maps, solution designs, implementation specifications and acceptance criteria.
* Ensure new solutions are embedded into operational processes, roles and ways of working.

**Change, Adoption and Benefits Realisation**

* Build stakeholder ownership and drive behavioural adoption from discovery through to operational use.
* Support communications, training, guidance and the AI Champion Network.
* Define baselines, success measures, benefit hypotheses and benefit owners before build.
* Monitor adoption, utilisation, quality and business outcomes after deployment.
* Use evidence and user feedback to improve, scale, pause or retire solutions.

**Governance and Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain accurate use-case, agent and benefits portfolios.
* Apply Eque2’s AI governance, risk, data protection, security and approval requirements.

new_jobs.description:
**Job Summary**

The Information Security Analyst 1 supports the day-to-day administration, operation, monitoring, testing, and documentation of the Bank's information security controls and technologies. This role is responsible for monitoring and triaging security events, administering established security solutions, supporting vulnerability management and incident response activities, maintaining security documentation and evidence, and assisting with risk assessments, audits, and regulatory examinations. The incumbent executes approved operational and control activities, identifies and escalates potential security risks, and contributes to the continuous improvement of the Bank's Information Security Program. This position operates within established standards and procedures and works under the guidance of senior security personnel for solution design, architecture, and material configuration changes.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Security Operations & Monitoring**

* Monitor, administer, and support assigned information security technologies and controls, including endpoint detection and response (EDR/XDR), managed detection and response (MDR), security information and event management (SIEM), identity and access management (IAM), network security, email and internet security, vulnerability management, cloud security, artificial intelligence (AI) security controls, data loss prevention (DLP), and data protection solutions.
* Monitor security alerts, dashboards, service queues, and system health indicators; perform initial triage, investigation, documentation, and escalation of security events and potential incidents.
* Validate security tool performance and coverage, identify monitoring or telemetry gaps, and coordinate corrective actions.
* Support incident response activities through evidence preservation, log collection, documentation, containment support, remediation tracking, and participation in on-call responsibilities, as assigned.

**Vulnerability, Access & Control Management**

* Review vulnerability findings, validate business impact and system ownership, monitor remediation efforts, and escalate overdue, high-risk, or recurring issues.
* Perform recurring control monitoring, operational checks, and testing activities related to secure configurations, privileged access, endpoint coverage, logging, encryption, alerting, certificates, and other assigned security controls.
* Execute approved security-control changes through established change-management processes, including testing, validation, implementation, rollback preparation, and documentation.
* Administer and support identity and access management processes, including access reviews, joiner-mover-leaver activities, authentication monitoring, privileged-access validation, service-account reviews, and provisioning support.
* Support data protection initiatives through classification, encryption, secure transfer, DLP monitoring, and security controls for approved cloud and AI-enabled solutions.

**Risk, Compliance & Security Program Support**

* Assist with security assessments, control reviews, technology implementations, cloud and AI security initiatives, security testing activities, and technology lifecycle management efforts.
* Support third-party risk management activities by collecting evidence, reviewing vendor security documentation, tracking issues, and assisting with remediation efforts.
* Contribute control documentation, testing results, and evidence for risk assessments, audits, regulatory examinations, Information Security Program activities, and compliance with applicable regulatory and security requirements.
* Collaborate with internal business partners, technology teams, auditors, regulators, and vendors to support operational security objectives and resolve security-related issues.

**Documentation, Reporting & Continuous Improvement**

* Maintain accurate and timely records within incident, change, project, vulnerability, and service management systems.
* Develop and maintain procedures, runbooks, operational reports, test results, findings, inventory records, and supporting security documentation.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, reporting, and repeatable processes through automation, scripting, workflow enhancements, APIs, and other approved technologies.
* Participate in cross-training and knowledge-sharing activities to strengthen team capabilities and ensure operational resiliency.

**Scope of Responsibility**

* Operate, monitor, test, troubleshoot, document, and support established information security controls and technologies.
* Exercise sound judgment within assigned authority and promptly escalate suspected compromises, customer-data exposure, control failures, privileged-access concerns, and other material security risks.
* Recommend operational improvements based on findings and analysis while working under the direction of senior security personnel for architecture, solution design, security standards, control selection, and material configuration decisions.
* Perform all duties in accordance with established policies, procedures, regulatory requirements, and information security standards.

**Compliance Responsibilities**

Complies with all applicable state and federal banking laws, regulations, and internal policies related but not limited to lending, operations, and deposit requirements, including Bank Secrecy Act (BSA), Anti-Money Laundering (AML) requirements, Office of Foreign Assets Control (OFAC) regulations, Customer Identification Program (CIP) requirements, Financial Elder Abuse reporting laws, Sexual Harassment prevention policies, information security and privacy requirements.

**Required Knowledge**

* Working knowledge of information security principles and practices, including least privilege, defense in depth, secure configuration management, vulnerability management, security monitoring, incident response, access controls, and change management.

**Company Description**

Since opening our first self-storage facility in 1972, Public Storage has grown to become the world’s largest owner and operator of self-storage facilities. With thousands of locations across the United States and Europe and more than 170 million net rentable square feet, we are also among the largest landlords globally.

Recognized as a Great Place to Work by the Great Place to Work Institute, Public Storage is a member of the S&P 500 and FT Global 500. Our common and preferred stock is traded on the New York Stock Exchange.

As the nation’s leading self-storage provider, we are known for our iconic orange doors and our commitment to delivering simple, reliable storage solutions to millions of customers.

 **Job Description**

Public Storage runs at a scale that makes the work interesting. More than 4,500 locations and growing, a national customer base, prices that move every day, and a footprint expanding across the U.S. and into Canada. Our Data and Analytics team sits with the business partners who own those decisions and works with them on the critical problems: pricing, promotions, marketing, operations, real estate acquisitions, and forecasting supply and demand.

Our platform runs on Google Cloud, including BigQuery, Vertex AI, Pub/Sub, Dataflow, Cloud Run, GKE, and Terraform, along with dbt Cloud, Airflow/Cloud Composer, Looker, and modern CI/CD. We're a small, senior team that operates like a startup inside an S&P 500 company. Short paths from idea to production, real ownership, and work that shows up in the business instead of in a slide deck.

Analysts here aren't a report factory. In this role you'll support our customer teams, working with customer data to answer the questions that change what we do the following week. You'll write real SQL against a modern warehouse, build dashboards people actually use, and learn the difference between a number that's interesting and a number that's decision-grade. You'll work closely with a senior data scientist who reviews your work and helps you grow, and you'll learn to work alongside AI analysis tools, which means your value is in framing the question and validating the answer.  
  
What You'll Do

**Analysis**

* Write clean, efficient SQL against BigQuery to answer business questions from our customer teams and other business partners
* Build and maintain dashboards and self-serve reporting in Looker, and support customer team partners in using them
* Investigate anomalies and trends in customer and business data: find the driver, not just the delta
* Support experiment readouts and performance measurement for customer initiatives, such as campaigns and promotions, with correct methodology

**Data Craft**

* Contribute dbt models and tests for the metrics you own, with documentation others can read
* Validate data before you publish it, with reconciliation, sanity checks, and known caveats stated up front
* Handle customer data responsibly, following our privacy and access standards
* Use AI assistants to accelerate query drafting and exploration, and critically review everything they produce

**Communication**

* Turn analysis into a short, clear recommendation with the assumptions visible
* Present to business partners in their language, not in yours
* Document metric definitions so the same question gets the same answer next quarter

  
**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in a quantitative or business field, such as statistics, economics, finance, business analytics, mathematics, engineering or computer science, with a minimum of 3 years of analytics, reporting or business intelligence experience; or Master's degree in one of these fields with 1 year of analytics, reporting or business intelligence experience; or an equivalent combination of education and experience sufficient to successfully perform the essential functions of the job
* Solid SQL skills, including joins, window functions, and aggregation logic
* Experience building dashboards in Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets modeling skills
* Clear written and verbal communication; comfort presenting to business stakeholders

Preferred

* 3+ years of analytics experience, including customer, marketing, digital, retail, or consumer analytics
* Experience with a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, or Databricks
* Exposure to dbt, Git, or version-controlled analytics workflows
* Working knowledge of Python or R for analysis
* Exposure to A/B testing, statistical significance, and experiment interpretation
* Experience with web and digital analytics such as Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, or clickstream data
* Interest in using LLMs and AI tools to accelerate analytical work

Skills & Technologies

* Core: SQL, Looker, Excel/Sheets, data storytelling
* Cloud & data: BigQuery, Google Cloud Platform, dbt (exposure)
* Analytics: cohort and funnel analysis, segmentation, trend and variance analysis, KPI design
* AI: prompt engineering, AI-assisted analysis with human validation

  
**Additional Information**

**Workplace Environment:**

One of our core values is working as OneTeam. We believe in the value of in-person collaboration while recognizing the importance of flexibility. Public Storage teammates are expected to work in the office five days per week, with the option to use up to three flexible remote-work days each month.

\*\*Sponsorship for Work Authorization is not available for this posting. Candidates must be authorized to work in the U.S. without restrictions or requiring sponsorship now or in the future. We do not provide training plans or support for F-1 OPT, STEM OPT extensions, or future visa sponsorship.\*\*

new_jobs.title: Data Analyste
new_jobs.description:
Lieu : Vélizy-Villacoublay, France

**Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance**
------------------------------------------------

Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d’activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l’environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d’euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l’innovation tels que l’IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays.

**Nos engagements, vos avantages**
----------------------------------

* Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée
* Un package de rémunération attractif
* Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes
* Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l’équilibre des collaborateurs
* Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu

**Votre quotidien**
-------------------

Rejoignez-nous sur le campus Vélizy qui héberge une grande diversité d’activités Thales, aéro, défense, civile,... A l'ouest de Paris, ce site offre un environnement de travail équipé des dernières innovations technologiques et propose des services permettant de concilier vie professionnelle et personnelle.

Vous rejoignez Thales LAS France à **Massy**, puis à **Vélizy à partir de 2027**. Rattaché au Responsable du Référentiel des Données du programme **VASSCO**, vous contribuez à fiabiliser les données et à les rendre exploitables pour les équipes métier. Le programme assure, pour le compte de la DMAé, le maintien en condition opérationnelle de près de 700 systèmes du SCCOA, en coordination avec une vingtaine de partenaires industriels.

Dans ce cadre, vous

* **Supervisez** la qualité des données avec le Data Manager, identifiez les anomalies et proposez des solutions.
* **Pilotez** les actions correctives avec les responsables des données concernées.
* **Diffusez** les bonnes pratiques de qualité des données auprès des acteurs du programme.
* **Analysez** les besoins métiers et créez les tableaux de bord nécessaires aux opérations et au reporting de la direction.
* **Collaborez** avec l’équipe IT au développement et à l’intégration des flux de données.
* **Accompagnez** les utilisateurs dans la prise en main des tableaux de bord et répondez à leurs questions techniques.

**Votre profil**
----------------

**Vous souhaitez fiabiliser les données d’un programme industriel et les transformer en tableaux de bord utiles aux équipes métier ?**

Votre formation ou votre expérience vous a permis d’acquérir des compétences en **modélisation, interprétation et gestion de la qualité des données**.

Vous avez une **expérience en BI** et savez analyser les données, repérer des tendances et proposer des améliorations.

La maîtrise de **Qlik** (de préférence) ou de **Microsoft Power BI** est appréciée, ainsi que votre capacité à résoudre des problèmes et à proposer des évolutions d’outils, des corrections automatisées ou des indicateurs mieux adaptés au pilotage du contrat.

Vous savez expliquer des sujets techniques à des interlocuteurs non spécialistes et accompagner les équipes dans l’application de la politique Groupe de qualité des données. Vous travaillez en équipe, prenez des initiatives et gérez vos priorités avec autonomie.

**Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !**

**Le mot de l’équipe**  
Rejoignez une équipe dynamique et conviviale, mobilisée pour la disponibilité opérationnelle du SCCOA et la satisfaction du client.

Thales, entreprise Handi-Engagée, reconnait tous les talents. La diversité est notre meilleur atout. Postulez et rejoignez nous !Le poste pouvant nécessiter d'accéder à des informations relevant du secret de la défense nationale, la personne retenue fera l'objet d'une procédure d’habilitation, conformément aux dispositions des articles R.2311-1 et suivants du Code de la défense et de l’IGI 1300 SGDSN/PSE du 09 août 2021.

### **Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Accounting, Finance, a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience in management consulting or project management from a public accounting firm or multinational company, or 5 years of experience with an advanced degree in business, accounting, or finance.
* Experience managing extended workforce governance, SLA performance, and vendor transitions.

* Master's degree, MBA, or equivalent advanced training in Finance.

* Experience administering vendor management tools and managing Statement of Work (SOW) workflows.
* Experience implementing Artificial Intelligence (AI), Robotic Process Automation (RPA), and automation technologies within a financial context.

**About the job**
-----------------

The Finance Operations team manages Google's cash transactions on a global basis and ensures that Google's incoming and outgoing cash processes are controlled, effective and efficient. As a member of this team, you'll find innovative ways to manage our complex set of transactions. You'll make processes more efficient and scalable, work to ensure the highest level of quality of our operations, and proactively minimize operational risk. Externally, you collaborate with our extended workforce partners and internally, you will collaborate across the multiple areas of the Financial Operations team.

The Finance Program Manager role serves as a core strategic and operational lead within Global Finance Operations. This position oversees extended workforce service delivery, enforces governance frameworks, leads continuous process optimization, and ensures robust access compliance across outsourced financial operations.

The name Google came from "googol," a mathematical term for the number 1 followed by 100 zeros. And nobody at Google loves big numbers like the Finance team when providing in depth analysis on all manner of strategic decisions across Google products. From developing forward-thinking analysis to generating management reports to scaling our automated financial processes, the Finance organization is an important partner and advisor to the business.

Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.
  
  
US: $128000 - $187000 (USD) + 15% bonus target + equity + benefits  
  
Learn more about benefits at Google.

* Lead extended workforce governance processes, Service Level Agreement (SLA) performance, and partner escalations while driving cross-functional strategy, worksite planning, and optimization initiatives.

* Manage the end-to-end financial process, including budgeting, forecasting, and actuals, in partnership with internal finance teams and vendors.
* Lead complex, cross-functional initiatives and system migrations, coordinate requirements across teams, and resolve programmatic escalations to maintain business continuity.

new_jobs.description:
**About us**

At **DDN**, we build the ultra-fast AI data infrastructure powering the world’s largest supercomputers and enterprise AI deployments - including NVIDIA and Elon Musk’s xAI -driving over **500,000 GPUs** globally at peak performance. Backed by a **$300 million Blackstone investment** at a **$5 billion valuation**, we are experiencing hypergrowth as revenue surges from **$500 million toward $1 billion in 2026**. Join a profitable, category-defining market leader expanding its global footprint - as we scale the next generation of enterprise AI intelligence.

**About the Role**

We are seeking an experienced **Principal IT Program Manager** to drive execution, governance, and alignment across the enterprise IT portfolio. In this role, you will partner closely with IT Leadership, Engineering, Security, Finance, Facilities, and business stakeholders to ensure successful delivery of strategic initiatives while maintaining visibility across priorities, dependencies, risks, resources, and outcomes.

You will serve as a trusted advisor to IT leadership, helping shape execution strategy, establish operational rigor, and drive cross-functional alignment across all areas of Information Technology, including Infrastructure, Networking, Cloud Platforms, Cybersecurity, Identity & Access Management (IAM), End User Computing, Enterprise Applications, Data & Analytics, and Workplace Technology.

The ideal candidate combines executive presence, operational excellence, and broad technical understanding with the ability to navigate ambiguity, influence senior stakeholders, and deliver measurable business outcomes at scale.

**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Drive execution of the organization's most strategic and business-critical technology initiatives.
* Maintain visibility across the entire IT portfolio, ensuring alignment with company priorities, roadmaps, budgets, and business objectives.
* Partner with IT leadership to develop portfolio strategies, prioritization frameworks, investment plans, and execution roadmaps.
* Identify, manage, and proactively resolve cross-functional dependencies, risks, resource constraints, and delivery challenges.
* Lead governance processes, executive reviews, operational cadences, and portfolio reporting activities.
* Develop and maintain executive dashboards, metrics, scorecards, and communication frameworks that provide visibility into portfolio health and organizational performance.
* Establish and evolve program management standards, operating models, governance structures, and best practices across the IT organization.
* Drive alignment across Infrastructure, Networking, Cloud, Cybersecurity, IAM, End User Computing, Enterprise Applications, Data & Analytics, Facilities Technology, and other business functions.
* Support enterprise-wide transformation initiatives, including cloud modernization, security programs, infrastructure expansion, workplace technology implementations, business systems transformations, and M&A integrations.
* Influence decision-making across technical and business teams without direct authority.
* Facilitate strategic planning, annual operating planning, and long-range roadmap development processes.
* Provide executive leadership with clear recommendations, actionable insights, and early visibility into organizational risks and opportunities.
* Champion operational excellence, execution discipline, accountability, and continuous improvement across the IT organization.
* Mentor and guide project and program managers while helping elevate organizational program management maturity.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of program and portfolio management experience within complex enterprise technology environments.
* Proven track record leading large-scale, cross-functional technology programs with significant business impact.
* Experience managing enterprise portfolios consisting of multiple concurrent programs, initiatives, and workstreams.
* Strong understanding of enterprise IT functions, including Infrastructure, Networking, Cloud, Cybersecurity, IAM, End User Computing, Enterprise Applications, Data & Analytics, and IT Operations.
* Exceptional executive communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior leaders and drive alignment across highly matrixed organizations.
* Deep expertise in portfolio management, governance, risk management, dependency management, resource planning, and organizational change management.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to connect technology investments to business outcomes.
* Experience building executive-level dashboards, reporting frameworks, and operational metrics.
* Proven ability to operate effectively in fast-paced, high-growth, and ambiguous environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, divestitures, and enterprise integration programs.
* Experience leading global technology transformation initiatives across multiple regions and business units.
* PMP, PgMP, PMI-ACP, SAFe, or related certifications.
* Experience implementing portfolio management, strategic planning, or governance frameworks at enterprise scale.
* Familiarity with regulatory, compliance, and security frameworks including SOX, ISO 27001, SOC, NIST, and related standards.
* MBA, Master's degree, or equivalent combination of education and experience.
* Experience partnering directly with executive leadership teams on strategic planning and operational execution.

Compensation Range: $185K - $250K

* Coordinating equipment delivery and staging.
* Coordinating vendor installation schedules.
* Coordinating Biomedical Engineering inspections and acceptance testing.

* Coordinating CMMS equipment records and project documentation.
* Tracking equipment from purchase/delivery through clinical deployment.
* Coordinating removal, replacement, or disposition of existing equipment when applicable.
* Confirming required activities are completed before equipment is released for patient care.

**Clinical Coordination:**

The Contractor must be comfortable working directly with hospital and clinical leadership and coordinating activities in active patient-care environments as well as all other hospital departments.

new_jobs.title: Manager, Data Analyst, Delivery Reporting & Tooling
new_jobs.description:
**About the Role**  
  
Leading at Uber means setting direction in motion, not waiting for perfect conditions. You'll build high-performing teams in ambiguous environments, make hard calls under pressure, and carry the weight of decisions that matter. If you lead with clarity, build with heart, and thrive in challenge this is where you'll make your mark.  
  
Global Delivery S&P sets the strategy, plans and performance standards for Uber's Delivery business across Restaurants, Retail and Direct. Within Data Products & Analytics, the Data Reporting & Tooling team builds the analytical products that Regional Ops and S&P teams use to monitor performance, investigate changes and take action. Its portfolio spans the Global Delivery Scorecard, centralized Ops dashboards, reporting automation, alerts and AI-enabled self-service tools.  
  
As the Manager, Data Analyst, you will lead the design, delivery and adoption of these tools. You will turn recurring business questions into intuitive, scalable products that help teams pressure-test assumptions, diagnose performance and make better decisions. You will own the tooling roadmap from discovery through launch and ongoing improvement, partnering with Data Infrastructure & Governance, which owns shared metric definitions, uMetric and the Data Mart.  
  
**What You’ll Do**  

* Act as a technical lead, including coaching analysts to own products from user discovery and design through build, testing, launch and upkeep, with clear accountability for quality and business impact
* Set the analytical products roadmap: understand the decisions Ops and S&P teams need to make, translate them into product requirements and prioritize reusable tools over repeated one-off reporting. Balance strategic builds, maintenance and urgent business needs
* Own the Global Delivery Scorecard and business review reporting experience, including automated MBR/GMBR views, intuitive drill-downs and performance diagnostics. Reduce manual preparation and help users move from monitoring results to framing the questions that matter
* Build and evolve shared Ops dashboards, diagnostic tools and actionable alerts. Assess Retail tools such as Cancellations, Funnel and market scorecards for Delivery-wide use; agree what to expand, consolidate, retain, transfer or retire
* Lead product design and hands-on prototyping, choosing the right tools for the audience and workflow. Set a high bar for usability, visualization and analytical storytelling, then iterate with users before scaling successful solutions
* Partner with Data Infrastructure & Governance to build on approved metrics and shared data assets. Define tooling requirements for coverage, granularity, freshness and quality; validate calculations and surface data limitations clearly in the user experience
* Develop AI-enabled analytical workflows with the AI & Automation team, including the S&P Knowledge Brain, Knowledge Library and Business Review repository. Use AI agents to accelerate research, build, testing and documentation; evaluate analytical answers, citations and calculations before release
* Own rollout, adoption and product health with Regional S&P, Ops and GSS. Agree acceptance criteria for regional migrations, document and train users, establish support and maintenance owners, and measure usage, time saved, reporting retired and alerts acted on

  
**Basic Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's Degree in Math, Economics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering or related quantitative fields
* 6+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence or analytical tooling, with a track record of translating business needs into reporting or tools that people use to make decisions

  
**Preferred Qualifications**  

* Advanced degree in Math, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering or other quantitative field
* Strong SQL and proficiency in Python or a similar language, with the ability to prototype analytical tools, automate workflows and review the accuracy of queries and outputs
* Experience owning analytical products from discovery and requirements through launch, adoption and ongoing improvement, with evidence of reducing manual work or scaling tools across teams
* Experience designing intuitive dashboards, scorecards, diagnostic tools or recurring business review experiences using BI tools such as Tableau or Grafana, or custom analytical applications
* Familiarity with marketplace, delivery, retail or e-commerce operations metrics
* Experience using AI coding or analysis agents to build and improve tools, and evaluating AI-generated answers for accuracy, traceability and usefulness
* Strong product judgment and critical thinking: frame business questions, prioritize high-impact use cases and turn complex analysis into clear decision support
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with experience gathering user feedback, driving adoption and partnering with technical teams on reliable, maintainable tools

  
For New York City, NY-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $167,000 per year - USD $185,000 per year.  
  
For San Francisco, CA-based roles: The base salary range for this role is USD $167,000 per year - USD $185,000 per year.  
  
For all US locations, you will be eligible to participate in Uber's bonus program, and may be offered an equity award & other types of comp. All full-time employees are eligible to participate in a 401(k) plan. You will also be eligible for various benefits.  
  
**Ready to Ride?**  
  
This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.  
  
You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

new_jobs.title: Sr. Business Intelligence Analyst
new_jobs.description:
### **Description**

**Candidates must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the communities served by Travis Credit Union, which include the following counties: Alameda, Colusa, Contra Costa, Merced, Napa, Placer, Sacramento, San Joaquin, Solano, Sonoma, Stanislaus, and Yolo. For hybrid and remote roles, candidates are still required to reside within a commutable distance of our corporate headquarters in Vacaville, California.**

*We are unable to sponsor or assume sponsorship of employment visas for this position. Candidates must have current authorization to work in the U.S. (no sponsorship available).*

**Schedule:** Full-time, exempt position with a remote work arrangement. Employees are expected to attend quarterly meetings on-site at TCU HQ. Standard schedule is Monday through Friday.

**Summary****:** The Business Intelligence Analyst at Travis Credit Union transforms complex data into strategic insights that support senior leadership and enterprise-wide initiatives. This role involves designing reports, dashboards, and analytical tools that guide both daily operations and long-term planning. Working independently and collaboratively across departments, the BI Analyst combines strong business acumen, technical expertise, and problem-solving skills to deliver actionable intelligence that drives informed decision-making and measurable value.

**Profile:**

* Designs and maintains analytic solutions such as dashboards, reports, and tools to support performance tracking and data-driven decision-making.
* Applies analytical techniques and models to identify trends, uncover opportunities, and support operational and strategic improvements.
* Extracts, integrates, and analyzes data from multiple sources using technical and programming skills to ensure accuracy and relevance.
* Communicates findings and insights clearly, translating data into actionable recommendations for business units and leadership.
* Conducts qualitative and quantitative analysis, including forecasting, segmentation, and root-cause evaluation to support business optimization.
* Collaborates with stakeholders across departments to assess needs, define metrics, and develop solutions aligned with organizational goals.
* Builds a working knowledge of data sources and structures to support effective analysis, reporting, and BI development.
* Identifies areas for improvement and contributes to the evaluation of business strategies and operational effectiveness.
* Ensures data integrity and reliability in reporting to support informed decision-making and performance management.
* Provides training and support to end users on accessing and interpreting BI tools, dashboards, and reports.

**Skills:**

* Proficient in designing and delivering clear, impactful data visualizations using business intelligence tools such as Tableau (strongly preferred), Power BI, or similar platforms.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences, including senior leadership and cross-functional teams.
* Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving abilities, including experience in root cause analysis, trend identification, and performance evaluation.
* Skilled in making complex data accessible and meaningful through dynamic visualizations tailored to diverse audiences.
* Hands-on experience with SQL for querying databases, data warehouses, and large datasets to support analysis and reporting.
* Solid foundation in data storytelling, business acumen, and collaborative consulting across departments.
* Ability to present findings, recommendations, and insights clearly and concisely to support strategic decision-making.
* Familiarity with programming languages such as Python for data analysis and automation is a plus.
* Experience using data to illustrate business performance and develop materials for audiences ranging from operational teams to executive leadership.
* Understanding of data management tools, relational and multi-dimensional databases, data warehouse design, and BI architecture.
* Detail-oriented with a strong aptitude for working with data; consistently accurate, thorough, and quality-focused.

**Reporting and Experience:**

* Reports directly to AVP, Business Analytics.
* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (e.g., Business, Analytics, Computer Science, or Statistics) and 5-8 years of professional experience in business intelligence or data analytics; or equivalent related work experience. Advanced degree (e.g., MBA with BI focus or MS in Data Science) preferred.
* At least 4 years of experience with BI tools such as SQL, Tableau, and Power BI, including dashboard development, data modeling, and performance metric design.
* Certifications in Tableau, SQL, and Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or higher preferred.

**Compensation**:  
Sr. Business Intelligence Analyst: Grade 18: $107,016.00 - $132,204.80 annually
  
  
**Benefits:**
  
At Travis Credit Union, we prioritize the well‑being of our employees and their families by providing a comprehensive Total Rewards program that supports their health, welfare, and financial security. In turn, this enables our employees to focus on delivering exceptional service to our members and meeting the goals of the credit union.

Eligible employees enjoy a robust benefits package, which includes:

* Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Mental health and wellness programs
* Employee performance incentive plan
* Merit-based salary increases
* 401(k) program with immediately vested employer match
* Generous holiday and vacation policies
* Exclusive TCU perks such as employee loan and credit card discounts

new_jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Drive end-to-end analysis of product data, market research, and competitor analysis to help drive understanding of key business lines and future company planning.
* Work cross-functionally with senior leadership and product teams to identify, assess, and execute key opportunities.
* Scope and execute zero-to-one projects to determine long-term value for the company.
* Support new go-to-market initiatives, including product launches and influencer campaigns.
* Manage vendor relationships by combining strategic analysis, execution, and operational rigor to help scale business.
* Manage and monitor vendor contracts, including both initial procurement and the renewal process.

**Requirements:**
-----------------

* Bachelor’s degree, or foreign degree equivalent, in Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Four (4) years of experience in job offered, Associate Analyst, Associate Consultant, or in a related occupation.
* Must be authorized to work in the United States. Sponsorship and/or relocation are not available for this position.

**Academic training or work experience must include:**
------------------------------------------------------

* Large-scale data analysis using SQL on Google Cloud BigQuery.
* Data mining using Braintrust.
* Building dashboards and data analysis using Hex with Python.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel analytics including pivot table, XLOOKUP, and data modeling.
* Regression Modeling.
* AI usage analytics and business outcome modeling using Python and SQL.

*This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.*

Applicants should email resume/cover letter to resumes@replit.com. Must reference REQ #R458 when applying.

Competitive Salary & Equity

Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

Short Term and Long Term Disability

Paid Parental, Medical, Caregiver Leave

Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

Commuter Benefits (*In-Office & US Only*)

Monthly Wellness Stipend

Autonomous Work Environment

In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (*In-Office Only*)

Quarterly Team Gatherings

In Office Amenities (*In-Office Only*)

**Want to learn more about what we are up to?**

* Self-driving Company
* Replit Agent at Scale
* AI Adoption
* Build Open-Source Apps

**Interviewing + Culture at Replit**

* Operating Principles
* Reasons not to work at Replit

To achieve our mission of making programming more accessible around the world, we need our team to be representative of the world. We welcome your unique perspective and experiences in shaping this product. We encourage people from all kinds of backgrounds to apply, including and especially candidates from underrepresented and non-traditional backgrounds.
